LinkedIn Text Formatter

Style LinkedIn posts with Unicode bold and italic text variants.

LinkedIn Text Formatter

Unicode bold and italic styling for LinkedIn posts — the style travels with the characters.

This is Unicode styling, not real formatting — it works anywhere plain text works, including LinkedIn posts and comments.

📖 How to use

  1. Type or paste the text you want to style.
  2. Pick a style: bold, italic, bold-italic, bold sans or italic sans.
  3. Click the copy button under the style you like.
  4. Paste it into your LinkedIn post — the styling travels with the characters.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Why Unicode instead of real formatting?

LinkedIn doesn't allow real rich text in posts, so this maps your letters to Unicode Mathematical Alphanumeric Symbols that look bold or italic everywhere.

Will everyone see the styled text?

Mostly yes on modern phones and browsers, but a few older devices show boxes for rare symbols. Bold sans is the safest choice for compatibility.

Is styled text accessible?

Screen readers may read styled letters oddly, so use styling for emphasis on short phrases, not entire posts.

Is my text uploaded anywhere?

No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser; nothing is sent anywhere.
